conditions: A requires differentiable action generation and critic with respect to action. Its dashed paths describe actor-objective chain rule, not Q-parameter optimization.
B scores already generated candidates using current critic and does not backpropagate selection through behavior generator.
State s conditions generator and critic; labels show this shared argument. Random seed and denoising intermediate steps are omitted.
Selection by reweighting or argmax does not prove action support or environment correctness.
